option_relations.rationale: The option 'Paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block' is identical to the provided leaf 'Paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block'.
Vagus-mediated paroxysmal atrioventricular block (VP-AVB) is a specific type or cause of paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block.
Neurally mediated (vasovagal) syncope is a common manifestation or consequence of significant bradyarrhythmias like paroxysmal complete atrioventricular block, especially when it leads to asystole.
Carotid sinus hypersensitivity can cause significant bradycardia or asystole, leading to complete atrioventricular block.
